architecture_deltas.delta: Every state-changing invocation receives immutable invocation_id, preferring host tool_use_id when present. Correlation key = invocation_id + session_id + generation + causal_id; session_id may contextualize but never serve as the sole current-effect pointer.

Split effect lifecycle into ADMISSION_DECISION, ENFORCEMENT_DECISION, EXECUTION_RECEIPT, WORLD_EFFECT_VERIFICATION, RESULT_REENTRY and COMPLETION_EVIDENCE. Successful execution may not retroactively imply admission or enforcement.

Generalize Realtime cancellation as a pending-effect state machine: PENDING may become CANCELLED_PRE_DISPATCH when the parent turn is cancelled. Once external submission may have occurred, outcome becomes SUBMITTED_UNKNOWN/UNKNOWN until verified and must not be blindly replayed.

Transfer Perception Control's typed NOT_COMPUTED and dependency-taint rule into GRID10 and sparse WorldNeed/WorldSlice: a protected COMPUTE_OFF variable must not be reconstructed downstream through dependent heads/operators. NOT_COMPUTED is distinct from false, zero, absent and UNKNOWN observation.

Retain VoiceSessionCapsule as a RAM-only compiled view, but bind each response-conditioning slice to source generations/freshness/provenance and a bounded compiler digest. Lesion/shuffle tests must prove which fields causally steer expression before expanding prompt payload.
